Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.perk

Record Class PerkTier

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.perk.PerkTier
Record Components:
id - the tier's key in perks.yml
displayName - the name shown to players, with its color codes
permission - the node that puts a player in the tier
priority - higher wins when a player holds several tiers' permissions
numbers - the Perk.Type.NUMBER built-in perks the tier sets or inherits
toggles - the Perk.Type.TOGGLE built-in perks the tier sets or inherits
parent - the ID of the tier it inherits from, or null (since 1.16.0)
icon - the item it wears in menus, or null for the default (since 1.16.0)
description - lines describing it in menus, with color codes (since 1.16.0)
addonNumbers - the number addon perks it sets or inherits, by key (since 1.16.0)
addonToggles - the toggle addon perks it sets or inherits, by key (since 1.16.0)
public record PerkTier(@NotNull String id, @NotNull String displayName, @NotNull String permission, int priority, @NotNull Map<Perk,Integer> numbers, @NotNull Map<Perk,Boolean> toggles, @Nullable String parent, @Nullable org.bukkit.Material icon, @NotNull List<String> description, @NotNull Map<String,Integer> addonNumbers, @NotNull Map<String,Boolean> addonToggles) extends Record
One named tier of perks.yml, such as vip. A snapshot.

A player belongs to the enabled tier with the highest priority whose permission they hold. A tier may inherit from a parent tier: each value comes from the tier itself, then up its parent chain, and only then from the server-wide default. The values here are the effective ones, inherited values included; a perk none of them sets follows the server-wide default.

A number value of PerkDefinition.UNLIMITED (-1) means unlimited, for perks that support it.

Since:
1.9.0
